evidence.quote: We propose a $30 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s records, plus $5 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
We propose a $36 million class fund, distributed automatically to the identified members, plus $7 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.
We can offer a $28 million class fund with automatic payments, plus $4 million in court-approved fees and expenses; any unawarded fees would go to the class.
The separate $4 million fee request covers the firm's invested time and expenses, subject to court approval.

summary: Plaintiff counsel raised fees alongside class relief, and the parties negotiated both before agreeing on the class fund. Whitcombe Reyes considered recovery of its firm's time and expenses when evaluating the offer, but the transcript does not show a trade of class recovery for fees, defense leverage of fee interests, or a misleading court declaration.
